content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm new to [product_name]. Can someone explain what 'summer/winter time' is and in which situations we should use it? Please help.
On which planet do you live?
I believe on Earth—specifically Asia. My question is, if I set 'summer/winter time', what changes will actually occur?
'Summer/winter time' is used in countries that observe daylight savings time.

In certain countries, clocks are adjusted twice per year. For example, in the Netherlands, the clock moves forward one hour during the last weekend in March and moves back one hour during the last weekend in October. Some believe it helps save energy. Many Western European countries observe it, though not all and some do so on different dates. If you have time-based functions, you can use the summer/winter time setting to automate these adjustments. The clock in [product_name] will update accordingly. You can use predefined dates or set custom ones.

analysis.insight_summary: A new user asked about the 'summer/winter time' feature in [product_name] and its application. Replies clarified that this relates to daylight savings time, providing examples of how clock adjustments occur in various countries. The information shared aimed to explain the concept and its impact, but offered limited technical detail for newcomers unfamiliar with the feature.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a straightforward, clear explanation about the purpose of 'summer/winter time' settings and advice on when and how to use them with [product_name].
